facts.fact: The Minister of Home Affairs and Cultural Heritage announced plans to computerise Civil Registry Department sub-offices across the country, saying it would reduce fraud linked to manual processes; the article gives no number of sub-offices, no timetable and no budget (The Herald, October 2025, month precision).
facts.system: computerisation of Civil Registry Department sub-offices

facts.fact: The computerisation of civil registry sub-offices was announced by the Ministry of Home Affairs and Cultural Heritage as its own drive, carried out by its Civil Registry Department under the Registrar-General; no partner or vendor is named (The Herald, October 2025).
facts.system: computerisation of Civil Registry Department sub-offices

systems.system: computerisation of Civil Registry Department sub-offices
systems.owner: Civil Registry Department, Ministry of Home Affairs and Cultural Heritage
systems.tiers: planned for sub-offices; the department has offices in all 10 provinces and 63 districts

note: The system is announced as a plan; the article does not say what the sub-offices will enter or how, beyond computerising offices that issue birth and death certificates, identity cards and passports.
